evidence.V1: Silhouette reads instantly as a stoppered potion bottle (chunky cap, collar notch, bulbous octagonal body tapering to a narrow foot); top view reads as an octagonal bottle with a centred cap; front outline symmetric (cap centre ~257 px vs body centre ~259 px) and A15 symmetry error X=0.0, Y=0.0.
evidence.V2: Clear big/medium/small: big octagonal body, medium shoulder panels + neck + ink stopper, small gold collar band and gold foot band plus the liquid line at the shoulder break.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: squat egg-shaped body widest at mid-height, short neck, oversized chamfered stopper; clearly an improvement over the stiff cylinder-like p4 anchor.
evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers on every facet edge, stopper rim, collar and foot band; they catch light as thin highlight strips in the stopper and foot close-ups.
evidence.V5: Close-ups (stopper, liquid line, foot) show clean flat facets with no pinches, seams, z-fighting or stray faceting; faceting is the intended vial design; stopper seated on collar and body seated on foot band with no gaps; A17/A18 pass, 0 flipped faces, 0 cap overlaps.
evidence.V6: Disciplined kit palette: one hue (teal) in 2-3 values (dark liquid, lighter glass) plus warm cream, gold accent and ink stopper; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap the hue cleanly and keep the neutrals.
evidence.V7: 544 tris vs small-class target 600 (ceiling 1500): at or under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material (LF_VertexColor), kit gold/ink/cream accents, chamfer scale visually matches the Gem_01 anchor; indistinguishable from the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct for a pickup: CanCollide off, CanTouch on, Box fidelity, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre (A12 pass).

artifacts: No hard artifacts. Minor: where the alternating cream/teal shoulder panels turn into the neck, the cream regions form small hook-shaped notches in the flat close-up (geometry turning, not a defect), and the thin teal chamfer strips between cream panels make the shoulder slightly busy.
top_fixes: Reconsider the alternating cream/teal stripe pattern on the upper glass: a single lighter-teal glass value (or cream only as a narrow highlight on 1-2 panels) would read more clearly as empty glass above the liquid and calm the busy pinwheel in the top view.
Optionally add one small secondary detail on the lower body (e.g. a thin gold band or a label plate) to break the large plain lower facets and strengthen the small-detail tier.
Keep the stopper chamfer slightly softer/wider so its top rim reads as a bevel rather than a hard octagon edge at 64 px.
